4 افلج as intrans.: see 1, former half, in three places. ＝
-A2- افلجهُ ٱللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ God made him to succeed against him; to overcome him, conquer him, or gain the victory over him: (S, O, K: *) and made him to excel him. (TA.) ―
-b2- And خَاصَيْتُ
فَأَفْلَجَنَى I contended in an altercation, disputed, or litigated, and he decided in my favour, and judged me to have prevailed against, or overcome, my adversary. (TA, from a trad.) ―
-b3- And افلج ٱللّٰهُ حُجَّتَهُ, (S, O, Msb,) or بُرْهَانَهُ, (K, *) God made his argument, plea, allegation, or proof, right, and manifest, or clear: (S, O, K: *) or established it. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
